'''Arkham Horror LCG: Chapter Two''' is the 2026 core release of the cooperative ''Arkham Horror'' card game. The [[TCGMix]] playtest covers the three-scenario Brethren of Ash campaign and carries investigator trauma and deck upgrades from one scenario to the next.<ref name="catalog" />
